name: California Certified Farmers' Markets
description: The official California Department of Food and Agriculture list of certified farmers' markets statewide, where California farmers sell directly to consumers.
fullDescription: The official California Department of Food and Agriculture list of certified farmers' markets statewide, where California farmers sell directly to consumers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hundreds of certified farmers' markets in California
- Markets listed by county, with location, days, hours, season, and manager contact
- Direct-from-farm produce and products
- Certification ensures products are California-grown
- Ask your market whether it accepts CalFresh EBT and Market Match
howToGetIt: View the CDFA directory (updated regularly; current list as of July 1, 2026) to find certified farmers' markets in your county, then check the market's days and hours.
keywords: CDFA, California farmers market, certified market, fresh produce, CalFresh, EBT, Market Match, local farm, California grown
